issues.jp_before: 「出口[でぐち]」{は|wa-topic}中国語[ちゅうごくご]{で|de-means}何[なん]{と|to-quote}言[い]います{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the preceding 「改札」は英語で何と言いますか item.
issues.action: Deleted; replaced with a new wa-topic item: このバスは空港まで何分かかりますか。

issues.jp_before: 先週[せんしゅう]{は|wa-topic}雨[あめ]{が|ga-subject}続[つづ]いて、どこ{に|ni-destination}{も|mo-total-negation}行[い]きませんでした。
issues.problem: The て of 続いて (te-sequence) was not marked, and どこへも is just as natural as どこにも.
issues.action: Marked 続い{て|te-sequence}; changed the slot to {に/へ|ni-destination}.

issues.jp_before: 朝[あさ]、パン{は/を|wa-contrast}食[た]べました{が|ga-but}、コーヒー{は/を|wa-contrast}飲[の]みませんでした。
issues.problem: 朝 alone means 'in the morning', not 'this morning' (that would be 今朝).
issues.action: Changed the English to 'In the morning ...'.

issues.jp_before: どの電車[でんしゃ]{が|ga-question}大阪[おおさか]{まで|made-until}走[はし]ります{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: 走ります is unnatural for asking which train goes to a destination.
issues.action: Changed it to 行きます; English changed to 'goes as far as Osaka'.

issues.jp_before: 何[なに]{が|ga-question}この町[まち]{の|no-possessive}名物[めいぶつ]です{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: 何がこの町の名物ですか is marked word order (the natural form is 名物は何ですか), so it is a poor model sentence.
issues.action: Rewrote it as この町は何が有名ですか。 ('What is this town famous for?'), f=1.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{が|ga-sub-clause}好[す]きな温泉[おんせん]{は|wa-topic}北海道[ほっかいどう]{に|ni-location}あります。
issues.problem: In a noun-modifying clause, 母の好きな is just as natural as が; that alternative was missing.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]{が|ga-sub-clause}近[ちか]いホテル{を|o-object}探[さが]しています。
issues.problem: 駅の近いホテル is an equally natural relative-clause subject; the alternative was missing.

issues.jp_before: 景色[けしき]{が|ga-sub-clause}きれいな道[みち]{を|o-path}歩[ある]きましょう。
issues.problem: 景色のきれいな道 is equally natural; the alternative was missing.

issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]{が|ga-sub-clause}住[す]んでいる町[まち]{へ/に|ni-destination}遊[あそ]び{に|ni-purpose}行[い]きました。
issues.problem: 兄の住んでいる町 is equally natural; the alternative was missing.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{が|ga-sub-clause}強[つよ]い日[ひ]{は|wa-topic}、電車[でんしゃ]{で|de-means}通勤[つうきん]します。
issues.problem: 雨の強い日 is equally natural; the alternative was missing.

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]{が|ga-sub-clause}着[つ]く{まで|made-until}、駅[えき]{で|de-place}待[ま]ちます。
issues.action: Changed the English to 'until my friend arrives'.

issues.jp_before: お年寄[としよ]り{が|ga-subject}前[まえ]{に|ni-location}立[た]った{ので|node-because}、席[せき]{を|o-object}譲[ゆず]りました。
issues.problem: The focus が is the subject inside a ので clause, and the 'why' says so, but it was tagged ga-subject; the batch's other ので-clause items use ga-sub-clause.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to ga-sub-clause.

issues.jp_before: 雪[ゆき]{が|ga-sub-clause}積[つ]もった{ので|node-because}、新幹線[しんかんせん]{が/は|ga-subject}遅[おく]れました。
issues.problem: 積もった means the snow piled up, not simply 'it snowed'.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'Because snow had piled up ...'.

issues.jp_before: 町[まち]{の|no-possessive}真[ま]ん中[なか]{に|ni-location}大[おお]きな川[かわ]{が|ga-existence}流[なが]れています。
issues.problem: 流れる is not an existence verb (ある/いる), so the skill id was wrong.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to ga-subject.

issues.jp_before: ほら、あそこ{に|ni-location}大[おお]きな船[ふね]{が|ga-existence}見[み]えます{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: が with 見える is the perception skill, not existence.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to ga-sense.

issues.jp_before: 空港[くうこう]{に|ni-destination}着[つ]い{たら|tara-conditional}、母[はは]{が|ga-subject}迎[むか]えに来[き]ていました。
issues.problem: The purpose に in 迎えに来る was not marked.
issues.action: Marked 迎え{に|ni-purpose}; the focus index is unchanged.

issues.jp_before: 平日[へいじつ]{は|wa-topic}バス{で|de-means}、休[やす]みの日[ひ]{は|wa-contrast}自転車[じてんしゃ]{で|de-means}通[かよ]います。
issues.problem: The の in 休みの日 was not marked.
issues.action: Marked 休み{の|no-possessive}日; the focus index is unchanged.
